choices.text: Gaming? Isn't this a rather remote spot for a break?

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Oh? It's you!

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Haha! It really is as they say — watch who you mention in idle talk. Never know who might show up. I was just thinking that if you were here, at least there'd be someone here to eat with me.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Thanks for the concern, but me? Get robbed on a delivery? I just finished one safe and sound. C'mon, we've known each other forever. Don't tell me you're doubting my skills now.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So you're...

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Relax! Smell that aroma?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wow, it smells amazing! Are you whipping up something delicious?

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Hehe, you know it! You're in for a treat, it'll be ready in just a minute.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: The boss from my last delivery runs a farm up in the mountains. There was a happy accident today — he miscounted the supplies. So, he sent me home with the extras.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: That fowl is really dope, oh, I mean... It's super fresh, and the meat is top shelf.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: There's even spring water from the mountains on our way back. Right place, right time... and I had a feeling that the "right people" might show up for the trifecta.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: That's why I decided to make something that I recall as — "Golden-Tempered Jade"!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wait... Is it really "Golden-Tempered Jade"!?

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: You've tried this dish before?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Haha, not at all. The name's impressive, though!

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Haha, it's not just the name. The taste is out of this world!

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Actually, I learned this dish from Leong, a helper from back home. He and my mother were from the same town, and he said my mother used to love this dish.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: That said, I didn't follow his recipe exactly. Tweaked it to suit my own tastes, y'see.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Brought the water to a boil, added a pinch of salt, then let the fresh fowl soak in it for a bit. Not for too long, though.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Then I mentally recited, "Fullmoon Egg, Crystal Shrimp, and Honey Char Siu; Fine Tea, Full Moon, and a Bountiful Year too." Scooped it right out once done.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: I had to repeat that step three times before placing the fowl into mountain spring water infused with Mist Flowers.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Hot and cold... Reminds you of a blacksmith tempering metal, huh?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: This is quite complicated...

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Haha, yeah, I think it's a bit of a hassle too, so sometimes I get lazy and skip a few steps...

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: But this is a special occasion! Such dope fowl can't go to waste. You'll see in a moment.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Anyway, we're currently at the final, trickiest step. That's when we drop the heat as low as we can go, and let the fowl poach slowly. All that's left after that is to have some patience...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How long until it's ready?

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Now that we've said all this, the timing should be just right. Not too early, not too late. Now, don't blink—

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: "Golden-Tempered Jade," ready to plate! See? When the surface shines like glazed glass, it means you got the heat just right. It looks amazing, and it tastes even better.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: C'mon, try some. See if you like it!

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: If you do, I'll make it for you again next time!

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: I don't really bother when I'm cooking for myself, but don't worry, I always follow the steps to the letter when I'm cooking for friends.

choices.text: You didn't get robbed, did you!?
